text:
maria: noticing a surge of reconnects after today's streaming canary, console fired the streaming-heartbeat SLO alert for several tenants :alarm_clock:
jamal: which region/canary? any sample ids?
maria: eu-west canary 1860007000 -> promoted. logs show proxy doing a half-close (FIN) shortly after idle, client immediately reconnects and we get duplicate resume attempts
maria: snippet:```
[proxy] 2026-03-23T10:12:01Z conn=xy FIN_SENT idle_timeout=30s route=sticky-42
[runtime] 2026-03-23T10:12:01Z session=abc resume_token=abc123 cached_kv=true
[client] 2026-03-23T10:12:02Z reconnect resume_id=abc123 -> new session created
```
sonya: we lowered proxy idle_close from 45s -> 30s in canary to free sockets faster. didn't expect resume token interaction like this :grimacing:
mikhael: some client libs treat server FIN as terminal and drop resume context, others attempt resume. combined with sticky routing TTL we can end up with two live session traces for the same resume_id
luis: customers reporting duplicate billing counters for streaming units
maria: telemetry: session_id flip + two open sockets for same tenant_id -> billing dupes. link (internal): https://console/internal/streams/tenants/12345/trace (redacted)
jamal: quick mitigation options: 1) make resume idempotent in runtime (accept overlapping resume requests if resume_id + client headers match), 2) suppress proxy half-close when resume token exists (proxy flag), 3) raise console dedupe window so alerts don't fire during churn
sonya: (ops) 2 is quickest but touches proxy code and rollout; want to gate behind FF. 1 is more correct long term but needs billing + token revocation checks
mikhael: agree. if runtime accepts overlapping resumes we still need billing dedupe to avoid double-charge races during the overlap window
jamal: prototype patch I'm thinking: in resume handler, if resume_id exists and the incoming connection presents the same client-fingerprint header, treat as resume-reattach -> return 200 + merge KV cache instead of creating a new billable session. pseudo:```python
def handle_resume(req):
    token = req.headers['x-resume-id']
    if token_store.has(token) and fingerprint_match(req):
        return attach_existing_session(token, req)  # non-billable attach
    return create_new_session(req)  # billable
```
sonya: sounds safe, but need to ensure token_store lookup is O(1) and doesn't increase p99. also add audit log for attach events
maria: immediate plan: jamal open PR for runtime minimal behavior -> no billing on reattach if fingerprint matches. sonya add FF in proxy to suppress half-close when resume token present and roll canary to 10% first. mikhael adjust console alerting to add a 15s dedupe window for streaming-heartbeat alerts for this tenant set
luis: I'll message CS to tell top-3 tenants we're investigating and to expect a short maintenance window
deploy-bot: deploy requested: canary/runtime/resume-accept-reattach -> queued on eng-runtime-canary
jamal: opening PR now, will tag @sonya for the proxy FF and @mikhael for console change. target: hotfix canary in next 2 hours, full rollout by EOD if green :thumbsup:
sonya: ack. will prepare FF and rollout doc snippet for support
mikhael: I'll update the alert rule: add condition `dedupe_window=15s` and annotate with incident link
maria: thanks everyone—keeping an eye on the tenant graphs, will post update after canary completes :eyes:
jamal: FYI: adding small test to e2e that simulates server FIN + client resume to prevent regressions
sonya: also adding a console note pane so SREs see "expected transient dedupe while rollouts in progress"
maria: perfect. let's sync if anything unexpected appears. :pray:
